verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk capability. There is a RESTful API with pagination for iterating over many records, an official MCP server for querying and managing tasks in natural language (e.g. "find all my incomplete tasks due this week"), rule actions for automation, and third-party sync tools like Hightouch that push data into Asana at scale. None of this explicitly documents updating many items at once. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk-write API endpoint, a native multi-select bulk-edit feature, evidence that MCP or AI tools act on many items in one operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.
